item.title: App for beekeepers
item.description:
App for beekeepers

We are developing a straightforward app to help beekeepers record inspections, log observations and manage hive tasks. Designed for practical, offline-friendly use.

Planned features

  • Inspection logs and notes
  • Simple health and treatment records
  • Harvest tracking and export

The app will be free of ads and aimed at small-scale beekeepers. Sign up for updates.

item.title: Beekeeping
item.description:
Beekeeping in Bergen

I keep bees with a focus on colony health, biodiversity and small-scale production. My work is based in and around Bergen, where local flora contributes to distinctive honey and resilient colonies.

Swarm collection — free and safe

If you find a swarm in a garden or urban area, I collect it free of charge and relocate it to a suitable home. Call +47 926 20569 to arrange pickup.

item.title: Contact
item.description:
Contact

For enquiries, orders or collaboration proposals, please contact me by email or phone. I respond to messages from the Bergen area and beyond.

Email: info@wenzel.no
Phone: +47 926 20569

Based in Bergen, I work locally and with an emphasis on community-driven projects. For press or larger collaborations, include details in your message and I will follow up with available times.

item.title: Farm
item.description:
Farm and local food

The farm focuses on sustainable practices and community engagement. We prioritise animal welfare, seasonal production and sharing skills locally.

Chickens and eggs

Free-range hens are kept with careful attention to welfare. Eggs are distributed through local channels and community initiatives.

Hatching & starter support

I assist with hatching and initial setup for those starting small backyard flocks — practical, step-by-step help.

Community projects

We collaborate with neighbours and local groups on small-scale projects that promote food resilience and knowledge sharing.

item.title: Oyster Mushrooms
item.description:
Oyster Mushrooms

Growing Oyster Mushrooms

I cultivate oyster mushrooms with care and love. Each mushroom gets time to develop naturally for the best possible taste and quality.

Forest Integration

Find my wooden stump in the woods with a QR code linking here! This is a unique way to connect nature with technology.

Community Idea

Picked some mushrooms? Support my work if you like it. This is about sharing nature’s gifts with the local community.

item.title: Tourism Items
item.description:
Handcrafted souvenirs from Bergen

I design and produce small handmade items rooted in local motifs. Ideal for gift shops, galleries or visitors looking for a tasteful memento.

Examples

  • Decorative maps and city silhouettes
  • Plant stands and interior accents
  • Custom and bespoke gifts

All items are made in small runs with a focus on durability and workmanship. Contact for orders or a portfolio preview.
